contradiction_resolution: Canning-Larson 2103.09902v2, equations (3.7)-(3.9) and Theorem 3.6, supplies the degree-four CE/Koszul resolution and identifies p_*script-W with Sym^2(E) tensor F^vee. Tensoring that resolution by script-W gives a complex whose first term is O_X(-2) tensor p^*F and whose middle term is p^*End(F); projective-bundle cohomology therefore yields the asserted short exact sequence. Canning-Larson 2208.02357v2, Section 10.3, explicitly restricts to the open where R^1s_*(Sym^2(E) tensor F^vee)=0, so the ensuing connecting cokernel is exactly R^1s_*End(F). Thus the statement in Lemma 10.6 that ambient-to-curve restriction is surjective merely because H^1(X,O_X)=0 is insufficient in general: the relevant ambient term is End(F), not O_X. There is no contradiction with any catalogued claim because contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the claims corpus contains no assertion about this restriction map. The finding complements FND-0061 and is distinct from the curve-level f=4/f=5 obstruction and the filtered-map condition R^1pi_*W_4=0 recorded in FND-0099, so it should not be merged. Its central correction is established, subject to the stated good-open qualification, and should be promoted.

scope.balanced_case: For F=O(4) direct-sum O(5), End(F)=O^2 direct-sum O(1) direct-sum O(-1), so R^1s_*End(F)=0.
scope.geometry: A degree-four finite flat Gorenstein Casnati-Ekedahl cover gamma:C->P over a P1-bundle s:P->B, embedded as the regular codimension-two zero locus of script-W=O_X(2) tensor p^*F^vee in the P2-bundle p:X=P(E^vee)->P.
scope.surjectivity_scope: On the standard good open B' where R^1s_*(Sym^2(E) tensor F^vee)=0, applying s_* identifies coker(q_*script-W->pi_*(script-W|_C)) with R^1s_*End(F). Outside B', the cokernel is only ker(R^1s_*End(F)->R^1s_*(Sym^2(E) tensor F^vee)).
scope.unconditional_result: The CE/Koszul resolution and R^i p_*O_X(-2)=0 for every i give 0->End(F)->p_*script-W->gamma_*(script-W|_C)->0.
